compounddef.innerclass: fmt::formatter< T, char, std::enable_if_t< std::is_enum_v< T > > >

briefdescription.para: Template helper class for working with strongly-typed enums.

detaileddescription.para: This class provides utility functions for converting enums to strings, strings to enum values, obtaining all enum values, and printing headers. It uses the magic_enum library to handle enum reflection at compile time.
